BiblicalUsage: Shimshai the scribe writes with Rehum against the rebuilding of Jerusalem. The king's answer stops the work until the second year of Darius.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a scribe's letter can stop a wall, and Shimshai's letter is the proof. I hold that the enemies of God's work have always had good handwriting, and the work still goes on.
